summary: Fusemachines Inc. filed an 8-K to correct beneficial ownership information for director Timothy Gocher, who previously over-reported shares held by Dolma Impact Fund I. Gocher lacks voting/dispositive power over those shares. The filing includes an updated 5%+ ownership table based on 28,985,302 shares outstanding as of July 1, 2026. No transaction, premium, or strategic event is involved—this is a routine compliance correction, not a special situation.
